'''Ensign Rosha''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She enlisted the help of a visiting asset of the Empire to help sabotage the satellite uplinks of the [[Exchange]] forces stationed at the [[Abandoned Reclamation Service base]], and put tracers on the satellites to track who had told the Exchange to spy on the Empire.<ref name="RP" />

With the help of the asset, Rosha received proof that the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] was to blame for spying via the crime syndicate, though she had initially believed that it was the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] backing the criminals.<ref name="RP" />
